about_the_game:
Step into the world of arcade nostalgia with Arcade Management Simulator - Demo, a fully playable experience where you get a hands-on look at managing, expanding, and customizing your own arcade—without any timers or restrictions!

Manage Your Arcade

Start small and build your dream arcade from the ground up. Set up arcade cabinets, gacha machines, and claw machines to create an exciting space that keeps customers coming back for more.

Experience the Full Gameplay

Enjoy all core mechanics without any waiting! Set pricing, manage your machines, and test your luck with over 300 collectible gachas. Every decision you make shapes the success of your arcade.

Build, Upgrade & Expand

Upgrade your arcade to maintain a top-tier reputation. Reinvest your profits to unlock new machines and customize your space to create the ultimate entertainment hub.

No Limits—Just Fun!

The demo offers full access to the core gameplay mechanics, letting you experience the thrill of running your own arcade without any restrictions. Play, experiment, and see how far you can take your arcade empire.

This is just the beginning—there’s much more to come as development continues. Jump in and start building your dream arcade today!

short_description: Build and manage your dream arcade! Purchase a variety of machines, set prices, maintain them, restock gacha machines, claw machines and vending machines. Collect and trade over 500 unique gachas. Upgrade your arcade, attract customers, and become the best arcade in town.
